final_message: I fixed `median` in `src/stats_utils.py`. I haven't run it, so the fix is untested. For lists with an even number of items, it returned the upper of the two middle values (`s[mid]`), which is why `[1, 2, 3, 4]` gave `3`. It now returns the average of the two middle values, `(s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2`, so that input gives `2.5`. Odd-length lists are unchanged.
